projectForm.submitLede: Answer a few questions, like a chat. An admin reviews your first project within 48 hours; after that, your projects go live right away.
projectForm.submitLedeTrusted: Answer a few questions, like a chat. You are a trusted maker, so your project goes live right away.
projectForm.editLede: Change anything, then save. Images are saved as soon as they are uploaded, removed, or moved.

status.pending: This project is waiting for admin review (within 48 hours).
status.rejected: An admin rejected this project: “{reason}”. Fix it, then save to send it back for review.
status.rejectedNoReason: An admin rejected this project. Fix it, then save to send it back for review.

projectForm.draftRestored: Your last draft ({time}) is back. Images need to be picked again.

steps.prompt: Start with what matters most: what was the key prompt? It opens your project card.
steps.media: Send some screenshots. Up to 3, compressed automatically. A demo video works too.
steps.tools: Which tools did you use? Pick everything, from AI agents to hosting.
steps.sessions: Tell us about the build sessions. One session = one sitting. The total becomes “X hours later” on the card.
steps.lessons: Last one: what did you learn? You can skip it, but this is what people look for most.

rules.own: The project is yours, or you were directly involved in making it.
rules.illegal: No adult content, gambling, scams, phishing, or anything illegal.
rules.privacy: Do not show other people's personal data or API keys in screenshots and prompts.
rules.respect: Criticism is fine, belittling is not.
